identity.captured_title: You are the Deep Research source-base reviewer for NebulaMind's galaxy-evolution wiki rebuild. Queue item 19 of 20 Core review: Sánchez, Sebastián F. (2020), Annual Review of Astronomy and Astrophysics, volume 58, pages 99-155, "Spatially Resolved Spectroscopic Properties of Low-Redshift Star-Forming Galaxies." Verified identity before submit: DOI 10.1146/annurev-astro-012120-013326; arXiv 1911.06925; ADS bibcode 2020ARA&A..58...99S. Mission Build an advisory-only, source-rich synthesis of the review's established findings, debates, quantitative measurements/calibrations, and primary source base for NebulaMind's galaxy-evolution wiki. Cover the resolved optical-IFS framework for low-redshift galaxies: ionization classification, stellar populations and star-formation histories, gas and stellar metallicity, radial gradients, inside-out growth, resolved star-formation main sequence, resolved mass-metallicity relation, Schmidt-Kennicutt relations, depletion times, quenching/retired regions, bars/interactions/environment, inflows/outflows/fountains, and the relation between local processes and integrated scaling relations. Safety and scope - Advisory/reference packet only. Do not edit a wiki, database, trust ledger, deployment, repository, or publication. - Treat the 2020 review as synthesis, not as primary evidence. - Use only sources actually cited in the review bibliography and published no later than 2020. - Exclude later survey releases/results, browsing spillover, and uncited claims. - Keep star-forming, composite, AGN, shocks, diffuse ionized gas, post-AGB/HOLMES and retired regions distinct. - Keep integrated, aperture-limited, spaxel, Voronoi-bin, HII-region and annular measurements distinct. - Carry spatial resolution/PSF, physical sampling scale, S/N cuts, inclination, deprojection, radial normalization and survey selection with every resolved claim. - Keep stellar metallicity, gas-phase oxygen abundance, total metal mass fraction and abundance ratios distinct. - Name every gas-metallicity calibration; do not mix direct-Te, recombination-line, empirical and photoionization-model strong-line scales. - Carry IMF, dust law, stellar-population library, star-formation-history parameterization, continuum subtraction and emission-line fitting with every derived mass/SFR/age/metallicity claim. - Distinguish surface densities from integrated quantities and local correlations from causal laws. - Keep molecular, atomic and total gas definitions distinct; carry CO-to-H2 conversion and depletion-time assumptions. - Distinguish local inside-out trends from progenitor evolution; do not infer time evolution solely from present-day radius. - Keep correlations induced by shared denominators, covariance, selection and spatial smoothing explicit. - Treat simulations and analytic models as context unless directly calibrated to cited data. Required atomic output 1. Review identity and scope map. 2. At least 12 established findings with stable ID REV19-E##, epistemic type, bounded statement, sample/scale/regime, confidence, and source keys. 3. At least 8 open debates/tensions with ID REV19-D##, competing positions, why unresolved in 2020, and source keys. 4. At least 8 key measurements/model calibrations with ID REV19-N##, exact value/equation/slope/range/parameterization, units, sample/scale, uncertainty/status, and source keys. Include where supported: resolved SFMS slopes/scatter, resolved MZR, oxygen-gradient normalization, depletion times, local Schmidt-Kennicutt slopes, characteristic spatial resolution, ionization-classification thresholds, equivalent-width cuts, and radial stellar-age/metallicity trends. 5. At least 6 "what remained unknown in 2020" items with ID REV19-U##, why they matter, and decisive observations/models needed. 6. Primary-citation harvest of 40-80 useful cited papers, separated into measurements/surveys, calibrations/methods, simulations/models, and supporting reviews. For each provide key REV19-P###, exact authors/year/journal/title, DOI or none, arXiv or none, ADS bibcode, role, exact review locator, and one-sentence scientific boundary. 7. DO_NOT_USE_UNVERIFIED quarantine for candidates not proven to be in the source base, post-2020, or with uncertain DOI/arXiv/ADS identity. State UNCITED_NOT_USABLE and never cite them in claims. 8. Composite identity ledger for the review and every usable source. Flag sample overlap, IFS survey/release overlap, aperture and PSF mismatch, ionization misclassification, metallicity-calibration mismatch, IMF/SPS/dust dependence, gas-tracer conversion, radial/deprojection convention, shared-variable covariance, simulation-only context, and method-context-only sources. Quality bar - DOI, arXiv ID and ADS bibcode must resolve to the same physical paper. - No inferred title/identifier hybrids; missing identifiers are "none." - Review synthesis cannot replace primary citations for load-bearing measurements. - Every emission-line ratio states dereddening and ionization selection. - Every SFR states tracer, timescale, IMF and dust correction. - Every mass/surface density states IMF and SPS assumptions. - Every metallicity states phase, calibration and abundance convention. - Every gradient states radial coordinate/normalization and fitted radial domain. - Every local scaling relation states spatial unit and treatment of censored/non-detections. - Every depletion time states gas phase and conversion factor. - Every claimed causal interpretation is labeled separately from correlation. - Supporting reviews do not count toward the primary-paper total. - Quarantined sources never appear in claim source lists. Return one self-contained packet ending exactly with: REVIEW_BASE_19_DR_COMPLETE_REFERENCE_ONLY
